visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a medium close-up of a young man and woman leaning into the frame, looking down at a screen. A smaller inset video shows clips of athletic lifts. The man has black hair and a black shirt; the woman has brown hair tied back and a grey sweatshirt. The background is a dimly lit, neutral-toned room. (2) The scene cuts to a brightly lit white bedroom/living area. The woman, wearing glasses and patterned pajamas, stands in the center. The man stands behind her, preparing to lift her. They face the camera. (3) The man attempts to lift the woman by the waist as they both smile, but the lift fails. He lets go, and they both laugh while looking at each other. (4) A second attempt occurs where the man lifts the woman briefly into the air. She kicks her legs as she is hoisted. Upon landing, she bends over, and the man reaches out to support her, both exhibiting exaggerated expressions of surprise and laughter. (5) In the final phase, the woman stands on a white plastic chair. The man crouches, hugs her legs, and successfully hoists her onto his right shoulder. He stands up straight, gestures with his left arm towards the camera, and walks around the room. The woman smiles broadly while holding onto his head for balance.
